message: Hi, my kid Skye is 7 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?
Hi! Yes, we do! We have Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu for ages 5-17. Skye would be a great fit. Classes are Monday and Wednesday evenings. Would you like to book a free trial class for her?
Yes, that sounds great! Can we book a trial class for the first available time?
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! And what's the best email to send the trial confirmation to?
You can send it to tester.juniper@gmail.com.
Got it! And what phone number should we have on file for you?
Perfect! Now I just need Skye's full name and date of birth to get her trial booked.
Skye's full name is Skye Juniper, and her birthday is October 22, 2018.

Awesome! Skye is 7, so she'll be in our Kids 5-10 Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu class. I have a couple of times available this week:

- Wednesday, July 8 at 5:15 PM
- Monday, July 13 at 5:15 PM

Which works better for you?
Let's go with Wednesday, July 8 at 5:15 PM.

Perfect! Skye is all set for her free trial class on Wednesday, July 8 at 5:15 PM. You'll get a confirmation email at tester.juniper@gmail.com. Just have her wear comfortable workout clothes. See you then!
